outcome: Bayley Scales of Infant Development II scores
cohort: Preterm infants between 25 and 30 weeks of gestational age with respiratory distress syndrome who received thin catheter surfactant administration were included.
finding: Infants who fail thin catheter surfactant administration (TCA) are at increased risk for short-term complications like pneumothorax, BPD, late-onset sepsis, and retinopathy of prematurity, despite comparable long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes.
